## Acceptance Criteria

- `AC-TASK-631-01` — A catalog covers uv, npm, pnpm, ~/Library/Caches, CoreSimulator, Xcode DerivedData and Archives, ollama, Docker and actcache; an entry is measured only after the user opts it into review; each carries a recreate class (rebuild from source, re-download, expensive to recreate, live state) and the owning tool's cleanup command as text, never executed.
